# Apple iPhone model numbers (the A#### on the back of the device).
#
# NOT a lookup source — a blocklist. These collide with Android device codes:
# A1724 is an iPhone SE, but Google Play's list also maps it to an Acer tablet.
# The build drops these codes so they miss instead of answering wrongly.
# Identify an iPhone by iPhone15,3 or by the part number on the box instead.
#
# Only codes are dropped; names.txt line indices are untouched.
# Source: "List of iPhone models", English Wikipedia, CC BY-SA 4.0.
